scope: M2 host-native Windows folder selection and owner-reported basic Android use

environment.browser: Chrome, Playwright 1.55.1 and Codex in-app browser

nativeManual.cancel: Owner confirmed Cancel; live Host showed Selection cancelled with previous path retained
nativeManual.selection: Owner confirmed Windows dialog opens and selection fills Host; observed real path and automatic name
nativeManual.noAutoEnroll: Picker result only fills form; Add folder remains separate
nativeManual.initialCancelReport: First report did not match a newly selected folder in live UI; repeated and verified rather than counted

phone.observed: Tracks screen, artwork, library navigation, active/paused row and persistent player visible
phone.status: Basic same-LAN use confirmed by owner report and supplied photo
phone.platform: Android Chrome identified by owner; model and versions not provided

commands.browser: RESONANCE_M2_E2E=1 RESONANCE_M14_E2E=1 RESONANCE_M15_E2E=1 RESONANCE_M17_E2E=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/library.spec.js tests/e2e/user-library.spec.js tests/e2e/m17-journey.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-product.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-pwa.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-accessibility.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-editorial.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-pagination.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-player-rail.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-quality-escalation.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-visual-polish.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-folders-artwork.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-playback-modes.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-library-transport.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-continuous-play.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-control-consistency.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-folder-picker.spec.js --workers=1 --reporter=json
commands.format: prettier --check on changed UI/tests/new documentation; git diff --check

boundaries: Picker absent from public music listener
Existing loopback peer/socket, Host, Origin/Fetch Metadata, JSON and custom header checks retained
No browser-provided path or command arguments to picker
Fixed self-executable helper, bounded output, cancellation and two-minute timeout
Native output fills form; canonical enrollment remains the existing separate operation
Interactive Windows only; manual fallback on other/headless hosts
Non-object/null picker input rejected without launching UI
Parent-held pipe terminates native helper if server exits; real child-process EOF regression passed

capture.rejected: First crop used viewport instead of document coordinates and showed page header; retained as host-form-final.jpg
capture.crop: Actual empty Add folder form; no private folder paths included

limitations: Browser native-result transport is controlled only for repeatable browser contract cases; native UI evidence comes from actual owner interaction and real COM checks
Private native screenshots and supplied phone photo are not published
No new performance benchmark or claim
Inherited symlink privilege and opt-in campaign skips remain explicit; full M2 quality acceptance not closed
